---
title: "Fourier Epicycles Drawing Tool"
format:
  html:
    css: styles.css
    include-after-body: app.js
    mathjax: true
---

  <div class="app">
    <div class="toolbar">
      <div class="group">
        <button id="modeDraw" title="Draw freehand" class="ok">✏️ Draw</button>
        <button id="computeBtn" title="Compute Fourier series from your drawing" class="primary">📈 Make Fourier</button>
        <button id="playBtn" title="Play/Pause reconstruction">▶️ Play</button>
        <button id="clearBtn" title="Clear drawing & trace" class="danger">🗑️ Clear</button>
      </div>

      <div class="group">
        <label class="slider" title="How many uniform samples to take from your path (affects quality & compute time)">
          <span>Samples</span>
          <input id="samples" type="range" min="64" max="2048" step="64" value="768" /> <input id="samplesNum" type="number" min="64" max="2048" step="1" value="768" /> <span class="val" id="samplesVal">768</span>
        </label>
        <label class="slider" title="How many epicycles (rotating terms) to use in the reconstruction (higher = more detail)">
          <span>Epicycles</span>
          <input id="epicycles" type="range" min="1" max="768" step="1" value="200" />
          <input id="epicyclesNum" type="number" min="1" max="768" step="1" value="200" />
          <span class="val" id="epicyclesVal">200</span>
        </label>

        <label class="slider" title="Animation speed (cycles per second)">
          <span>Speed</span>
          <input id="speed" type="range" min="0.1" max="5" step="0.1" value="1.0" /> <input id="speedNum" type="number" min="0.1" max="5" step="0.1" value="1.0" /> <span class="val" id="speedVal">1.0×</span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="group">
        <label class="switch" title="Draw the epicycle circles & arms">
          <input id="showCircles" type="checkbox" checked /> <span>Show circles</span>
        </label>
        <label class="switch" title="Connect the end of your stroke back to the start before sampling">
          <input id="closePath" type="checkbox" checked /> <span>Close path</span>
        </label>
        <label class="switch" title="Show or hide your original drawing stroke">
          <input id="showDrawing" type="checkbox" checked /> <span>Show drawing</span>
        </label>
        
      </div>

      <div class="group">
        <button id="exportBtn" class="ghost" title="Download your drawing as SVG">💾 Export</button>
        <label class="btn ghost" title="Load an SVG file previously exported">
          📂 Import <input id="importFile" type="file" accept="image/svg+xml" />
        </label>
        <button id="fitBtn" class="ghost" title="Fit drawing to canvas">📐 Fit</button>
        <button id="exampleBtn" class="ghost" title="Load an example star">⭐ Example</button>
        <button id="equationBtn" class="ghost" title="Show series equation">∑ Equation</button>
        <button id="transformBtn" class="ghost" title="Plot real series f(t) = x(t) + y(t)">📊 Plot Cycle</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="main">
      <div class="stage">
        <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
        <div class="hint">Draw with mouse or touch. Scroll to zoom; hold <span class="kbd">Space</span> and drag to pan. Click <span class="kbd">Make Fourier</span>, then <span class="kbd">Play</span>. Use sliders to refine. Double‑tap to toggle play.</div>
      </div>
      <aside class="side">
        <h3>Status</h3>
        <div class="row"><span class="muted">Points drawn</span> <span class="val" id="pointsCount">0</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="muted">Samples used</span> <span class="val" id="samplesUsed">0</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="muted">Epicycles used</span> <span class="val" id="epicyclesUsed">0</span></div>
        <div class="row"><span class="muted">FPS</span> <span class="val" id="fps">—</span></div>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <h3>How it works</h3>
        <div class="muted" style="padding:6px 6px 10px;">
          Your drawing is sampled into <span id="sExplain">768</span> equally spaced points along its length. We compute complex Fourier coefficients \(C_k\) and animate epicycles following
          \(\sum_k C_k e^{i2\pi k t}\). Increase <em>Epicycles</em> for more detail.
        </div>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <h3>Tips</h3>
        <ul class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px 16px; padding:0; line-height:1.6;">
          <li>Use <span class="kbd">Fit</span> to center/scale your drawing.</li>
          <li>Try fewer <em>Samples</em> for faster recompute, then increase.</li>
          <li>"Close path" is best for logos/shapes. Turn it off for open strokes.</li>
          <li>Import/Export uses normalized coordinates so it scales to any canvas.</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="hr"></div>
        <div class="foot">Built with vanilla JS. Drop this file into your site or embed in an <span class="linklike" onclick="copyEmbed()">iframe</span>.</div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="eqModal" class="modal hidden" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <div class="modal-head">
        <div class="title">Fourier series equation</div>
        <button id="eqClose" class="ghost sm" title="Close">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div id="eqContent" class="modal-body"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Transform (real plot) modal -->
<div id="tfModal" class="modal hidden" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
  <div class="modal-card">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <div class="title">Real Fourier series plot \(f(t) = x(t) + y(t)\)</div>
      <button id="tfClose" class="ghost sm" title="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <div class="muted" style="margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.5">
        The curve shows the real function \(f(t) = x(t) + y(t)\) rebuilt from the
        Fourier series, plotted on a Cartesian plane.
      </div>
      <div style="width:100%;height:260px;">
        <canvas id="tfCanvas" style="width:100%;height:100%;display:block"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
